facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart) is a national supermarket chain focusing on value-retailing across multiple product categories.
facts.quote: Avenue Supermarts Limited (DMart) is a national supermarket chain, with a focus on value-retailing. We offer a wide range of products with a focus on the Foods, Non-Foods (FMCG) and General Merchandise & Apparel product categories.

facts.statement: As of March 31, 2026, DMart had 500 stores with a retail business area of 20.58 million sq. ft.
facts.quote: Since launching our first store in 2002 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, we have grown to 500 stores with a retail business area of 20.58 million sq. ft. spread across Maharashtra (128), Gujarat (75), Telangana (48), Andhra Pradesh (47), Karnataka (50), Madhya Pradesh (29), Tamil Nadu (35), Rajasthan (28), Punjab (24), NCR (20), Chhattisgarh (8), Uttar Pradesh (3), Uttarakhand (1), Goa (1), Orissa (1), Haryana (1) and Daman (1).

facts.statement: As of March 31, 2026, the company operated 84 distribution centres and 12 packing centres.
facts.quote: As of 31st March, 2026, we had 84 distribution centres and 12 packing centres.

facts.statement: At the end of FY 2025-26, DMart had 20,994 permanent employees and 75,577 contractual employees.
facts.quote: At the end of FY 2025-26, we had a total of 20,994 permanent employees and 75,577 employees were hired on contractual basis.
